{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jokoflow''' was a river on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. It entered the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Efavan/Legends|Efavan]], spilled into [[Lake Joko]], and continued through the city.
